base: 15-second continuous first-person fairytale dark-ride shot, vertical 9:16. An original exquisite pearl-ivory princess palace with midnight-blue roofs, delicate champagne-gold tracery, pale blush roses and clear cool moonlight. Premium stylized cinematic 3D feature-film world with intricate physically believable materials and gentle depth, crisp architecture, luminous but not hazy. The visitor glides at seated eye level on a silent invisible floating ride carriage; stable horizon, no roll, no fast spins, no shaky handheld. A subtle trail of tiny champagne-gold motes leads onward. Every described action happens visibly. Preserve the established palace architecture and palette. Keep important objects inside the central 65% of the portrait frame. No people, human faces, humanoid figures, text, subtitles, logos, UI, hearts, snow or Christmas decorations. Natural dimensional parallax; never animate a flat photograph. No dialogue.

shots.title: 港湾初见
shots.prompt: Begin just above a still moonlit lake. Glide toward the distant illuminated palace. Floating lily lights wake one after another beneath the camera, reflecting precisely in the water. The water opens into a narrow garden canal; end entering between two carved ivory posts. Three beats: quiet dark water, a ribbon of warm lights awakens, a promising entrance reveals itself.

shots.title: 睡莲水道
shots.prompt: Continue forward into a palace water garden. Giant delicate white water lilies slowly unfold as the carriage passes; champagne-gold pollen rises from their centers. Ripple reflections travel across the carved stone banks. Follow a soft curve left toward an arch covered in pale pink climbing roses; end framed by the rose arch.

shots.title: 玫瑰长廊
shots.prompt: Glide through a long vaulted passage of climbing roses above the canal. Near roses open gently in sequence; their pale petals lift, briefly turn into translucent glass-like butterflies and drift forward. Show real layered foreground parallax and fresh detail beyond each arch. The final rose arch reveals ornate golden palace gates ahead.
